name: CrowdSec Security Engine (Open Source)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted IDS/IPS security engine with behavioral detection, community detection scenarios and community blocklist; no vendor-enforced software license host or event quota for the engine.
watch_out: Requires your own Linux/Windows/Docker/Kubernetes infrastructure, log access, remediation integrations and security operations. Premium threat intelligence, paid blocklists and CrowdSec Console premium features are not included.
